tombstone: Siddhartha at the Bodhi Tree, 100s–200s CE. Pakistan, Gandhara. Schist; overall: 73.7 x 57.2 cm (29 x 22 1/2 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Leonard C. Hanna Jr. Fund, 1997.151
title: Siddhartha at the Bodhi Tree

provenance.description: (Bodhicitta, New York, NY, sold to the Cleveland Museum of Art)
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH

description: The tree under which the Buddha reached enlightenment marks the center of the composition. It had been under worship by local villagers, for it was known to be the residence of a nature divinity, who here emerges from the tree and altar to praise the Buddha. The altar itself is covered with kusha grass used in the context of sacrificial offerings. At the base of the altar, the earth goddess has risen from the ground and kneels before him in reverence.
